demonstrates:
with 4000 evidence items across 200 cases plus 4000 on one case, and ANALYZE run: the selective case read used evidence_items_case_active_idx and file versions used evidence_files_item_idx. No sequential-scan counter-case arose: at roughly half the table the planner still chose a bitmap index scan, because these rows are narrow enough that the bitmap is cheaper than the heap. That differs from deadlines, reviews, tasks and the graph, and is recorded rather than engineered away. No latency claim is made. Plans:
{
  "evidence_by_case_selective": "Sort  (cost=63.85..63.90 rows=19 width=39)
  Sort Key: status, evidence_type, created_at, id
  ->  Bitmap Heap Scan on evidence_items e  (cost=4.43..63.45 rows=19 width=39)
        Recheck Cond: ((case_id = 'd704aa0f-bab3-4c62-b7c2-09a686460feb'::uuid) AND (retention_state <> 'erased'::text))
        Filter: (organisation_id = '0fd57726-8685-439c-be41-2936c3ecb83b'::uuid)
        ->  Bitmap Index Scan on evidence_items_case_active_idx  (cost=0.00..4.42 rows=19 width=0)
              Index Cond: (case_id = 'd704aa0f-bab3-4c62-b7c2-09a686460feb'::uuid)",
  "evidence_by_case_dominant": "Sort  (cost=575.89..585.92 rows=4011 width=39)
  Sort Key: status, evidence_type, created_at, id
  ->  Bitmap Heap Scan on evidence_items e  (cost=59.45..335.84 rows=4011 width=39)
        Recheck Cond: (case_id = '841e3674-4fb1-419e-9a07-21efa6c653a3'::uuid)
        Filter: ((retention_state <> 'erased'::text) AND (organisation_id = '0fd57726-8685-439c-be41-2936c3ecb83b'::uuid))
        ->  Bitmap Index Scan on evidence_items_case_id_idx  (cost=0.00..58.45 rows=4022 width=0)
              Index Cond: (case_id = '841e3674-4fb1-419e-9a07-21efa6c653a3'::uuid)",
  "files_by_item": "Sort  (cost=23.22..23.23 rows=5 width=20)
  Sort Key: version DESC
  ->  Bitmap Heap Scan on evidence_files f  (cost=4.33..23.16 rows=5 width=20)
        Recheck Cond: (evidence_id = '0256ace8-545d-4052-96eb-ee3965a547b1'::uuid)
        ->  Bitmap Index Scan on evidence_files_item_idx  (cost=0.00..4.32 rows=5 width=0)
              Index Cond: (evidence_id = '0256ace8-545d-4052-96eb-ee3965a547b1'::uuid)"
